title: Separate scalar clock ticks from Weather Context projection rebuilds

gates.name: Host weather projection and display regression suite

verify: Before changing production behavior, obtain fresh task-scoped RED from the current Weather Context path and a focused host probe: each 20 Hz Main Display refresh calls WeatherCapability.projection(now), which reloads and decodes the persisted weather record and rebuilds the display-ready projection. Do not use W13 evidence as this task's RED/GREEN.

Keep the required W13 scalar clock/date/colon refresh unchanged. Inside the existing Weather Context owner, reuse a capability-owned display-ready WeatherProjection snapshot so repeated scalar reads reuse it without repeated cache decode/projection construction.

Invalidate only after an accepted successful Weather refresh, when the observed validated location changes through the existing location reader, or at an existing projection boundary required by the current semantics: selected-city date/day-night or pressure-trend boundary and the 24-hour freshness transition. A failed refresh, network signal, timer state, lifecycle callback or unchanged scalar tick must not invalidate the snapshot. Do not add a public method, event, notification, edge, dependency or provider implementation.

Add focused host coverage in the existing WeatherContextTest.kt convention. From isolated in-memory state, distinguish repeated projection calls from one accepted refresh/location/freshness invalidation, prove failed refresh preserves the last successful projection, and retain the existing four-card, selected-city timezone, day/night, pressure-trend, fresh/stale and empty-contour semantics.

Run the clean build, complete host unit suite and static diff gate. Fresh output must show the existing Main Display scalar cadence remains available while the unchanged display-ready weather input avoids repeated record decode/build; no Main Display ticker lifecycle, Forecast, Yandex provider, Timer & Alert, audio, gesture or target-device behavior is changed.

Do not run or require emulator, physical-device, target-ROM, 1280x720 readability, fullscreen, keep-screen-on or audio evidence for this bounded host-verifiable optimization. Stop and route to /spec-design if the smallest implementation needs a new module, graph edge, public capability contract, event/message boundary, dependency or owner; stop and return to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if the scope changes accepted behavior or cross-feature ownership. Do not modify historical task records, scheduler checkpoint, terminal state, RTM lifecycle or Planning Revision.

gate_summary.target_evidence: DEFERRED by task scope; no target-device runtime PASS claimed

accepted_residual_risk: W14 is host/static proof only; Samsung/custom-ROM/1280x720 physical evidence remains DEFERRED and no target-device runtime PASS is claimed.

evidence_required: [FT-001-AC-002 / REQ-002] Expected RED: repeated scalar-tick reads cause repeated WeatherCacheStore record loads and display-ready projection construction. GREEN: repeated calls for the same valid input reuse the Weather Context snapshot, while one accepted refresh/location/freshness boundary causes one new projection used by the existing four-card renderer. Compare cache-read/decode/build counts and card output; artifact is the focused WeatherContextTest result plus bounded source-diff evidence.

[REQ-007 / REQ-022 / REQ-025] RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: the accepted weather refresh, selected-city timezone/day-night, pressure-trend, offline-cache and stale-empty behavior is already the required product baseline; a meaningful RED would require intentionally breaking that behavior rather than observing this internal memoization debt. Alternative proof: fresh deterministic host regression output compares successful-refresh, failed-refresh, location-change, selected-city boundary and 24-hour stale transition results, including four empty contours and uninterrupted clock/timer availability; artifact is the task-local WeatherContextTest output.

[Runtime safety] Expected: host probes use isolated in-memory Weather Context/cache/provider fixtures with a known reset state, safe rerun and cleanup between cases; no live credential, persistent production storage, target device or private neighbor-state write is used. Compare fixture state before and after; artifact is the task-local test result and protocol evidence.
purpose: Remove the confirmed TD-W13-001 upstream projection/decode debt while keeping the W13 scalar refresh cadence and all accepted Weather Context ownership and freshness semantics.
success_outcome: The existing 20 Hz scalar clock refresh can read a capability-owned display-ready WeatherProjection snapshot without repeated persisted weather decode/projection construction; accepted successful refresh, validated location change and existing projection/freshness boundaries rebuild only the Weather Context snapshot, while public boundaries and product behavior remain unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not reopen, rewrite, normalize or replace TASK-003-T3-FT-001-W2, TASK-014-T3-FT-001-W11, TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W12 or TASK-016-T3-FT-001-W13, their identity, lifecycle, evidence or protocol history.
Do not change the W13 Main Display ticker owner, scalar 20 Hz cadence, card renderer, Activity lifecycle gating or public WeatherReadPort/consumer contract.

Do not change Weather Context provider refresh cadence, normalized data, cache/history storage rules, projection meaning, freshness result, Yandex adapter behavior or API-key handling; only memoize the existing display-ready result inside its owner.
Do not optimize Forecast Sessions or any forecast ticker, Timer & Alert or audio behavior, gestures, Settings behavior, target-device evidence or product UI.
Do not add a module, dependency, event/message infrastructure, public contract, graph edge, product behavior or business orchestration outside Weather Context.

forbidden_scope: TASK-003-T3-FT-001-W2, TASK-014-T3-FT-001-W11, TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W12 and TASK-016-T3-FT-001-W13 identity, lifecycle, evidence and protocol history
.protocols/AUTONOMOUS-RUN/status.md and all scheduler checkpoint or terminal-state fields
app/src/main/kotlin/com/hozayushka/app/display/ and Main Display ticker, renderer, clock/date/colon or gesture behavior
target-device, target-ROM, emulator, 1280x720, fullscreen, readability, keep-screen-on, audio, live credentials and secret-bearing artifacts
new module, dependency, public contract, graph edge, event/message boundary or owner
stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-design if projection snapshot invalidation cannot remain inside the existing Weather Context owner and Main Display → Weather Context read boundary without a new module, edge, public contract, dependency or Planning Revision change.
Stop and return to /feature-to-tasks FT-001 if execution exposes a different accepted behavior, AC ownership, tier, dependency or material cross-feature scope.

Stop before a GREEN claim if the host probe cannot distinguish repeated scalar reads from accepted refresh/location/freshness invalidation while preserving existing weather semantics; do not substitute target-device evidence.
Stop before any modification outside the hard write boundary, direct storage bypass, credential use or scheduler/terminal-state write.

constraints: Task-owned implementation delta is only FT-001-AC-002 / REQ-002: preserve the existing four-card display-ready input while decoupling its upstream projection/decode work from the required W13 scalar 20 Hz clock refresh. REQ-007, REQ-022 and REQ-025 are governing weather/time/failure constraints and regression guards, not new feature behavior.

Weather Context is the primary capability owner for the memoized display-ready projection and remains the sole owner of refresh, normalization, cache/history, freshness and projection semantics. Main Display remains a read-only consumer through the existing Main Display → Weather Context edge.

Invalidate only after accepted successful refresh, observed validated location change or the existing selected-city/date/day-night/pressure-trend/24-hour freshness boundary needed by the current projection; failed refresh, network status, timer state, lifecycle and unchanged scalar ticks do not invalidate it.
Keep all mutable persistence behind Weather Context's existing private WeatherCacheStore path; no consumer or test writes production weather storage directly.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-002 / REQ-002 task-owned implementation delta: repeated scalar reads reuse one Weather Context display-ready projection snapshot without repeated persisted record decode/projection construction; an accepted weather input change yields one rebuilt projection and the existing exact four-card composition remains.

REQ-007 / REQ-025 regression target: successful refresh and validated location change invalidate the owner snapshot, failed refresh preserves the last successful result, and crossing the existing 24-hour freshness boundary returns four stale empty contours without affecting the clock/timer path.

REQ-022 regression target: selected-city timezone, calendar date and day/night projection remain correct across the existing required time boundaries; pressure arrows retain the accepted history thresholds and fallback.

.memory-bank/contracts/boundary-map.md#dependency-graph and .memory-bank/contracts/capability-interfaces.md#main-display-to-weather-context: the implementation remains inside Weather Context and the existing read edge, with no new module, owner, public contract, event or dependency.

Focused host quality probe: isolated counting cache/provider fixtures distinguish repeated scalar projection reads from refresh/location/freshness invalidation and leave all disposable state reset after each case.
